structural_change: RTL-BUILD-S81 (owner 0dv 10-18): NEW link-port leaf of the end-slice master (dsdv_slice_lepw/_e = ot_s81sl_slice + this leaf + 2 x dsfd_coll_lane): outward ring-port pin flops, per-lane 512-flit SRAM landing FIFOs (2 x 5 ot_sram_1r1w_512x128, as the coll lane's own replay/receive arrays), RX pair re-assembly, fault collector. Fills residual row 1 (lt_lk 8 x 512 undriven). Host plane (coordinator 10-18): seq_host f_host 515 / f_lf 4 / f_ks 53 out, t_host 77 / t_kd 54 in, as typed non-ring link frames (HOST / KS in, THOST / TKD out). Gate 3eb62a102 FAIL (GPL-0305 divergence): macro columns fronted the W/E pin faces (W band 15 um) with a 0.4-um sliver between the columns' halos and W/E pins at 99% face demand (5.9/um). Re-floorplan: 475.2 square (W/E 4.85/um), two 5-SRAM columns centred with a 21.6-um channel, >=31-um W/E std-cell bands, 119-um N/S bands. Edges: ro -> lane endpoint +2, lane -> ri +1, reset release +1. S81-LEPV 10-18: leaf gains HOST_EN (default 1 = this kit, unchanged function); host logic moved into generate blocks; HOST_EN 0 top ot_s81sl_lep_nh = kit s81sl_lepnh (s_0S / s_0N / s_7S). HOURLY-S81/LEP 432 trial: outline 475.2 -> 432 x 432 (W/E faces 5.3/um, under the 6/um rule; area -17%), the two 5-SRAM columns close their centre channel (halos abut; lane-1 W->E traffic goes over the 97-um N/S bands, as before), 20-um W/E std-cell bands beyond the halos (the 3eb62a102 divergence had a 15-um band at 5.9/um), column centred vertically.
